_comment: F31/F32 bounded Forge actor configuration only. No buildable, blueprint, station, recipe or transport is registered by this file. Canonical live placement and character/world transaction adapters remain dependencies. All other station/attachment definitions remain with their owning work orders.

forge._comment_tuning: Starting bounds for one present tap-start channel; F47 may tune them. Recipe seconds/radius remain in recipes_forge.json. No catch-up production after an oversized host tick, no automatic retry or saved/offline channel.
forge._comment_authority: The host-only station actor resolves a stable built UID and an actual body. A trusted canonical context reader supplies current world/character snapshots and per-character modal/combat/homestead policy. The existing canonical commit adapter owns each completed unit's authenticated inventory CAS, debit/output, stable receipt and durable result. Missing/unknown context or adapter refuses; source-only plans are never Craft success.
